## 🛠 Bug Fixes
- Fix 1: Revised LOS code for Cropping and Flipping
- Fix 2: Re-enable LOS Checking for selected HASL Maps
NOTE: this code will now work with geo maps - both the 33 x 10 hex and 17 x 20 hex sizes and those HASL maps which previously supported LOS.  

None of the changes have caused games to crash during testing to date. All that will happen is that the LOS Engine will fail when a game is 
opened if a bug is encountered. It will be safe to continue to play but only the basic VASSAL LOS string will display.
